aviation_incidents.headline: 法國軍用飛機南錫附近墜毀 機型尚未確認
aviation_incidents.summary: 一架法國軍用飛機於2026年10月20日晚在法國東北部南錫附近墜毀。Pont-à-Mousson市長Henry Lemoine表示，飛機約於當地時間23時35分在Rogéville、Domèvre-en-Haye與Tremblecourt之間墜毀。事件引發夜間搜索行動。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: French military aircraft crashes near Nancy; type not officially confirmed
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A French military aircraft crashed near Nancy in northeastern France late on October 20, 2026. Henry Lemoine, mayor of Pont-à-Mousson, said the aircraft went down at approximately 23:35 local time in an area between Rogéville, Domèvre-en-Haye and Tremblecourt. The crash prompted a major overnight search operation.

aviation_incidents.headline: 俄羅斯Su-30戰機加里寧格勒墜毀 機組員彈射獲救
aviation_incidents.summary: 俄羅斯國防部證實，一架俄羅斯Sukhoi Su-30戰機於2026年10月21日在加里寧格勒地區執行預定訓練飛行時墜毀。國防部表示，機組員已彈射，並由地面搜救隊尋獲；該部稱飛行員生命無虞。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Russian Su-30 crashes during training in Kaliningrad, crew ejects
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The Russian Ministry of Defense confirmed that a Russian Sukhoi Su-30 fighter crashed in the Kaliningrad region on October 21, 2026, during a scheduled training flight. The ministry said the crew ejected and was recovered by a ground search and rescue team, and that the pilots’ lives were not in danger.

aviation_incidents.summary_en: Simple Flying’s headline reports that an American Airlines Boeing 787 made an emergency landing at O’Hare (ORD) and says one person was hospitalized. The headline describes the brakes as dragging. The outlet’s summary uses more tentative wording, saying the pilots warned of a possible brake problem before landing.

aviation_incidents.headline_en: LATAM Airlines A320 evacuated after engine fire at Lima airport
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A LATAM Airlines Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320), registration CC-BFS, was evacuated after an engine fire while on the tarmac at Jorge Chávez International Airport (LIM) in Lima, Peru, on October 19, 2026. The aircraft was taxiing toward the runway as it prepared to operate flight LA 2302 to Piura (PIU). The report said the fire began in the port-side CFM56 engine; its cause has not been established.

taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺北市長蔣萬安赴議會報告松山機場遷移計畫等案時，再次呼籲中央現在就啟動遷移案。他表示，遷移關乎臺北及臺灣未來數十年的發展，並主張應努力面對問題、克服困難，朝目標推動。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taipei Mayor 蔣萬安 urges central government to begin Songshan Airport relocation planning
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taipei Mayor 蔣萬安 urged the central government to begin the Songshan Airport relocation process while reporting to the Taipei City Council on the plan and other matters. He said the relocation concerns Taipei and Taiwan’s development over the coming decades, and called for efforts to address obstacles and pursue the goal.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 松山機場遷移構想待審慎評估 空勤基地尚無替代方案
taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺北市長蔣萬安宣佈規劃遷移松山機場，打造臺北人工智慧（AI）園區。內政部長劉世芳表示，空勤總隊松山基地目前沒有替代方案。她指出，空勤總隊操作直升機需要一定場地，才能支援救災、救難及醫療後送；遷移要選擇何處，須審慎評估。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Songshan Airport relocation plan draws scrutiny as air-service base lacks an alternative
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taipei Mayor 蔣萬安 announced plans to relocate Songshan Airport and develop a Taipei artificial-intelligence (AI) park. Interior Minister 劉世芳 said the Airborne Service Corps’ Songshan base currently has no alternative. She said helicopter operations need suitable space to support rescue work and medical evacuation, and that any relocation destination requires careful assessment.

The certificate authorizes flight operations with operators and participants for the purpose of conducting market surveys.

new_information: The FAA announced it issued BETA Technologies a Special Airworthiness Market Survey Certificate for its ALIA eVTOL aircraft (A250).
The certificate authorizes flight operations with operators and participants for market surveys.
The authorization expands the geographic scope of BETA’s operations, allowing the aircraft to fly in more environments and gather more data.
BETA Technologies founder and CEO Kyle Clark said operators can now experience the A250 firsthand and begin planning how it fits into their businesses.
